_derivation.note: official_fields.json is curated from the Square Connect v2 API reference objects (Payment, ProcessingFee, CardPaymentDetails, Location, Order, PaymentRefund, Customer). Fields are derived from the official object schemas at developer.squareup.com/reference/square/objects. Reporting-relevant scalar fields are included; deeply-nested variant fields (device_details.*, application_details.*, bank_account_details.*, wallet_details.*) are excluded as they do not bear reporting metrics. The Square API is versioned via a request header (Square-Version), not the URL path; api_version refers to the header value pinned in connector.py.
_derivation.manifest_field_coverage: All 9 fields in manifest.json source_capabilities.fields are present in official_fields.json with matching kind and source_field. These 9 fields are marked exposure='exposed'; all fields in fetchable sections (PAYMENT, PROCESSING FEE, CARD DETAILS, PLATFORM CONTRACT) are also 'exposed' (exposure_policy=catalog_driven); excluded sections are 'excluded'.
_derivation.supermetrics_enrichment: No Supermetrics enrichment snapshot is used for Square in this iteration (official source is authority and self-contained; no network fetch required to regenerate). A future widening iteration MAY add a Supermetrics or Airbyte manifest enrichment source to validate tier assignments -- enrichment is never the authority per the playbook.

probe.structural_note: Square list endpoints (GET /v2/payments) return whole Payment objects over a begin_time/end_time window (limit=1 for a probe) paginated by an opaque cursor. Fields are ratified by presence in the returned object; a field absent from a non-empty object is recorded empty. processing_fee and card_details availability depend on settlement/source_type and are recorded per-observation.

excluded_sections.LOCATION: Location objects are not returned by the daily payments pull; they come from a separate GET /v2/locations call (used by discover_accounts for topology, not for per-payment projection). The location_id scalar is already exposed on the Payment (PAYMENT section).
excluded_sections.ORDER: Square Order objects are not fetched by the daily pull; payment.order_id is a scalar id (already exposed in the PAYMENT section). Full Order fields require a separate Orders API (RetrieveOrder / SearchOrders) call, not performed by the daily pull.
excluded_sections.REFUND: Individual PaymentRefund objects are not fetched by the daily pull; payment.refunded_money.amount (already exposed as the refunds metric via PLATFORM CONTRACT) is a scalar total on the Payment, not the list of PaymentRefund objects. Requires a separate GET /v2/refunds call, not performed by the daily pull.
excluded_sections.CUSTOMER: Customer objects are not expanded by the payments pull; payment.customer_id contains only the customer id string (already exposed in the PAYMENT section). Full Customer fields require a separate GET /v2/customers/{id} call per payment, not performed by the daily pull.

_exposure_note: Story 25.9: exposure_policy=catalog_driven. Fetchable sections (PAYMENT, PROCESSING FEE, CARD DETAILS, PLATFORM CONTRACT) have their fields set to exposure=exposed in api_catalog.json; excluded sections (LOCATION, ORDER, REFUND, CUSTOMER) have their fields set to exposure=excluded with honest reasons. The daily pull calls GET /v2/payments, making Payment fields and their embedded ProcessingFee[] and CardPaymentDetails available; all other object types require separate endpoint calls not performed here.
